title: memo.recorded payload v1
description: The memo summarizer wrote (or rewrote) the learning memo of one highlight thread. Appended after each tutor reply in a highlight thread, replacing the memo's title/body (upsert on memo_id), until the learner edits the memo (memo.edited); after that no further memo.recorded is appended for that memo_id. title and body are the memo_summarizer.note v1 output copied verbatim; the harness adds the rest.

memo_id.description: 'memo_' + the highlight_id tail: one memo per highlight.

thread_id.description: 'thr_' + the highlight_id tail: the popup thread the memo summarizes.

source_event_ids.description: Events given to the summarizer: the content.highlighted event, then every chat event of the thread up to and including the reply that triggered this memo, in position order.
